devtools.observation: Same-frame on/off shows historical infrared spatial texture behind the stable stars/grid at 128.8 and the full 267.8 degree dome. Observation red mode hides W3 with the sky red; returning to ordinary mode restores the opt-in image and camera/instant. The real time ruler moved the selected report instant from 21:00 to 18:00 Asia/Shanghai: the stars and twilight shifted and W3 was absent while the user toggle remained on; selecting 21:00 restored night W3 at the new exact frame. WXML object-list disclosure contains survey band, acknowledgment, split copyright/ODbL, rights URLs and machine-readable manifest URL. DevTools M31 details -> /sky/sources/index?reference=M%3A31 -> navigateBack returned to Sky with the same W3 full dome still painted; the prior Android canvas failure remains unverified/unfixed.
devtools.platformLimit: The DevTools simulator still composites Canvas over ordinary WXML controls; it cannot prove phone controls, gesture quality or native composition. No per-request DevTools network trace was collected; local HTTP and image observation are separate evidence.
